'''"Ja Ja Jabba"''' was one of the dozens songs written by a [[Unidentified young new recruit|promising Jedi recruit]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. It featured in a songbook specifically created to remind [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] of his homeworld.
